name: Wellington International Airport
notes: No prayer, multi-faith, meditation or quiet room is listed on the official site as of 18 Oct 2026. All 407 URLs in https://www.wellingtonairport.co.nz/sitemap.xml were fetched directly and full-text scanned for prayer, multi-faith, chapel, meditation, quiet room, faith room, reflection room and musalla: the only hits are news and community-award pages (school prayer groups, wildlife 'sanctuary'). The 'At the airport' hub (/services/) lists maps, baggage, lounges, WiFi, family facilities, lost property, accommodation, conference centre, security, international procedures and accessibility, with no prayer space. The terminal map SVGs carry no prayer label. The site's own search (/search/?q=) for 'prayer' returns 1 result (a news story about students), for 'chapel' none, and 'quiet' and 'faith' only news and community pages. A room may exist without being listed.
